searches.name: Essential business services
searches.description: Recurring services embedded in everyday operations.

companies.name: Northline Systems
companies.description: Field service and dispatch infrastructure for commercial equipment maintenance teams.
companies.customers: Commercial HVAC and industrial maintenance operators. Dispatchers and technicians use the system throughout each workday.
companies.criticality: Coordinates technician dispatch, parts availability, and work-order billing. An outage would directly affect service delivery and cash collection.
companies.concern: Needs clearer evidence of retention and the proportion of revenue from recurring contracts.

evidence.title: Workflow overview
evidence.detail: Sample evidence: dispatch, work orders, and invoicing in one operational workflow.

companies.name: MeridianOps
companies.description: Managed infrastructure and operational IT services for regulated industrial businesses.
companies.customers: Manufacturing groups and logistics businesses with multi-site infrastructure.
companies.criticality: Manages network availability and core business infrastructure, with embedded service teams and long-term support agreements.
companies.concern: Revenue is not available. Employee count suggests scale, but does not establish the revenue threshold.

evidence.title: Services overview
evidence.detail: Sample evidence: managed infrastructure and operational continuity services.

companies.name: Clearpath Industrial
companies.description: Inventory and procurement software for industrial distributors.
companies.customers: Regional distributors and aftermarket parts suppliers.
companies.criticality: Connects stock availability, purchasing, and customer orders. Core to order fulfillment and working-capital management.
companies.concern: Revenue estimate is indicative and requires confirmation.

evidence.title: Platform overview
evidence.detail: Sample evidence: inventory management and purchasing automation.

companies.name: Atlas Fleet
companies.description: Fleet maintenance software that keeps commercial vehicles on the road.
companies.customers: Commercial fleet operators with distributed maintenance teams.
companies.criticality: Powers maintenance scheduling, compliance records, and vehicle availability. Essential to keeping a working fleet operational.
companies.concern: Validate contract duration and expansion across customer locations.

evidence.title: Maintenance workflows
evidence.detail: Sample evidence: scheduled maintenance, compliance, and asset availability.

companies.name: Relay Systems
companies.description: Quality management software for precision manufacturers.
companies.customers: Precision engineering and medical device manufacturers.
companies.criticality: Manages quality checks, non-conformances, and traceability required for releasing products.
companies.concern: Existing conversation underway; avoid duplicate outreach.

evidence.title: Quality overview
evidence.detail: Sample evidence: product traceability and release management.
